🔥 Welcome to OPPS, an open-world city adventure where your skills and choices shape your journey.

Start from the beginning, improve your character, master new abilities, and build your path to becoming one of the top players in the city.

⚔️ Compete in exciting PvP battles
🏆 Take on challenges and climb the leaderboards
💪 Train your character and unlock new abilities
🚗 Customize and upgrade your vehicles
🎒 Discover gear and collect items
👥 Play with friends and create your own story

Whether you’re competing for the top spot, exploring the city, or building your character, OPPS is ready for you.
